what.title: Slice is born to teach by building.
what.intro: Slice.js is born to be a framework where you can learn, in a practical way, the core patterns behind component-based programming and modern frameworks.
what.purpose: Its purpose is to help you build complete web applications from a vanilla perspective, without non-standard abstractions or syntax outside HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It does not seek to compete. It seeks a different way of building.
what.logoCaption: A practical ecosystem for building and understanding modern frontend systems.

why.title: Why
why.text: To close the gap between documentation theory and the daily reality of building products.

how.title: How
how.text: By embracing native browser APIs, explicit component lifecycles, and a transparent architecture.

not.title: What it is not
not.text: A trend chase. Slice is a long-term learning and shipping framework, not a popularity race.
